newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips power to session highs, Dow up 110.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips power to session highs, Dow up 110.

text.p: The Dow industrials rallied to new highs for the day late Tuesday, shrugging off a shaky performance in the technology sector.
The Dow stood at 6562, up 110 points for the day. NYSE advancing issues extended to a roughly five-to-two edge on fairly heavy volume that exceeded 460 million shares.
"There is a hope in the market that we could still have an extended cycle if we can get through this period of strength," said Barbara Marcin, vice president at Citibank Global Asset Management.
The Nasdaq Composite remained six points lower at 1211.
